lines.text: The Tally Basin was free country once. Dust, cattle, and folks who minded their own business.
Then three powers carved it up.
In the sinking swamps, Captain Snig and his Greenskin Corsairs: goblins, slimes, and lizards with bad tempers.
In the dead woods, Queen Vex and the Hollow Court, where the bones get up and walk.
And in the rich east, King Odo the Gilded. His knights, his taxes, and the thing he keeps in the castle yard.
That leaves you. An outlaw captain with fifty gold, a grudge, and one town to your name: Dry Gulch.
Pick your captain. Clay Harrow and his revolver, Goro and his katana, or Wren and her rifle. Or design your own in the Chunk Lab, and ride as the Stranger.
Your job is to take the basin back, one territory at a time. Break Snig's Wreck and the Pale Hall, and the gates of Castle Gilt swing open.
Each day starts on the map. Red markers show where you can strike: anywhere that touches your land.
Pick a territory to see the job, the danger, and the bounty. Then ride out.
Move with W, A, S, D, or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, use the stick.
Click to attack. Guns fire where you aim. With keys or touch, your shots find the nearest enemy in front of you.
Blades work in combos. Keep attacking for three hits. The third one slams the ground.
Press space, or right click, to dodge roll. Nothing can hurt you mid-roll, so roll straight through a charge.
Every weapon has a special move. Press F when the gold bar fills. Fan the hammer, a dead-eye shot, a whirlwind, a nova of spellfire.
You carry two weapons. Press Q to swap between them.
You don't ride alone. Your posse follows you into every fight.
Give orders with keys one to four. Follow me. Hold this spot. Charge that point. Or focus everyone on a single target.
Fallen enemies drop scrip. Spend it at the surveyor's stakes.
Press E at a stake to build a barricade, a gun nest that shoots on its own, a campfire that heals your posse, or a powder keg for anyone who wanders too close.
Every territory is a different job.
On a raid, burn every tent inside the palisade. Their standard stays locked until the last tent falls.
On a rescue, smash the cage and walk the prisoner home alive. Freed outlaws join your gang.
On a heist, grab three strongboxes and run for the wagon. The alarm goes up at the first box.
And when they come to you, hold the town hall through every wave.
Open chests for gold, and grab hearts to heal. But if a chest has teeth, back away and start shooting.
Back in camp, spend your gold.
Hire outlaws, and choose who rides with you. The saloon adds seats to the posse.
Buy weapons at the armoury, and choose the two your captain carries.
Build up Dry Gulch. A smithy for damage, a doc for health, watchtowers for defence, and a stable for a mount.
At nightfall, your land pays out. Then the enemy moves.
When they raid, ride out and defend, or trust your garrison and hope. Lose Dry Gulch, and it's all over.
Each power has a stronghold, and a boss who doesn't fight fair.
Snig and King Odo both take to the saddle at half health. Chain your powder kegs, focus down their healers, and roll when something big comes at you.
Take the basin. Break the crown. Saddle up, outlaw.
Three powers carved up the Tally Basin. Goblin pirates, a court of skeletons, and a king with a T. rex.
You're the outlaw who takes it back.
Every day, pick a territory on the map, and ride out.
Raid their camps, break prisoners out, rob the strongboxes, and hold your town against the waves.
Drag the stick to move. Tap attack to fight. Blades chain into a three-hit combo.
Roll to dodge, and hit special when the gold bar fills.
Your posse fights beside you. Spend scrip at the stakes on gun nests and powder kegs.
Win, and the land pays gold. Spend it in camp on new outlaws, weapons, and a horse.
But at night, they raid you back.
Break all three powers, and the crown is yours.
Ink Outlaws: Crown of Dust. Every frame, drawn in code.
